caseName: Western Union Telegraph Co. v. Atlanta & West Point Railroad
caseNameFull: Western Union Telegraph Company v. Atlanta & West Point Railroad Company
summary: Appeal from the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit.
